rewrites.//: Every route is client-side, so a cold load of /ledger has to be answered with the shell. Asset paths are excluded on purpose: a missing chunk must 404, not come back as index.html with a 200. Answering a script request with HTML is what turns a stale tab into 'Expected a JavaScript module but the server responded with text/html', which names neither the cause nor the fix.

headers.//: The entry document must never be cached: it is the only file that knows which hashed chunks belong to this build. A stale copy asks for chunks that no longer exist.
The service worker decides when the app updates, so it is checked on every load too.
Hashed filenames: the content can never change under a given name, so it is safe to keep forever.
